description: A painting of a woman in a dark patterned headscarf and shawl holds a small child against her chest; both look straight out with grave expressions. Behind them, under a ragged canvas awning, stand sacks stacked along the side and several other people in shadow, with a sunlit dry landscape and bare thorny trees beyond. There is no visible text, no frame, and nothing graphic; the dress and setting look like a rural East African relief camp, with no modern technology visible.
reason: Shows a mother and child beside grain sacks under a tent in a dry camp setting, but the card is a 2015 London safe-deposit vault burglary, so the picture is of a different event.
